text:
alex: Heads up — Polaris (enterprise) wants to start a 10-day POC tomorrow at 09:00 PST. Their security team is insisting on SOC 2 or a signed bridge letter + temporary evidence access. Can we get a bridge letter + redacted SOC2 excerpts + presigned S3 links before their kickoff? Need legal + security approvals asap. cc @maria-legal @tariq-sec

maria-legal: We can issue a short bridge letter stating SOC 2 is in process and an ETA for the final report. Requirement checklist from our side: (a) exact list of files to share, (b) NDA executed (mutual), (c) whitelist of requester IPs/emails, (d) ack that links expire and are not the final report. I can draft in 2-3 hours.

tariq-sec: Security will allow a limited bundle via presigned URLs with IP restrictions and 72h TTL. We require: requester emails, requester IP CIDRs (or single IP), and confirmation that files have been scrubbed of customer PII. We'll enforce a 300MB total cap and an MD5 checksum on each file. :shield:

ben-eng: Engineering can stage files at s3://redwood-poc-evidence/1936001234-polaris/ and produce presigned URLs once legal signs off on the file list. We'll remove screenshots and redact resource IDs. Example generation (we'll add proxy-based IP check):
```
# generate presigned (TTL seconds)
aws s3 presign s3://redwood-poc-evidence/1936001234-polaris/controls_excerpt.csv --expires-in 259200
# proxy will add X-Forwarded-For IP allowlist
```

acct-rep: Polaris prefers HelloSign for e-signing NDAs. They also asked for the bridge letter to include the auditor name and an estimated month for delivery. They want a one-page quick-access checklist for their procurement team.

maria-legal: Auditor name can be included if client NDA allows mention of third parties; I will check with audit firm. Draft NDA + bridge letter uploaded to legal drive (link posted). Note: bridge letter will explicitly say "audit in progress, preliminary excerpts provided, final SOC 2 report will be delivered by [month-year]. This bridge letter is not a substitute for the final report."

alex: Proposed runbook: 1) HelloSign NDA -> 2) legal posts bridge letter -> 3) security confirms file list & IPs -> 4) eng generates presigned URLs -> 5) acct-rep sends links to Polaris. Can we hit kickoff tomorrow?

tariq-sec: That's fine if NDA signs today. Please provide exact requester emails and static IPs. We'll block all other access. We also require logs be truncated (last 30 days only).

ben-eng: Starting export now for the approved artifacts. Approved filenames suggested for redaction: controls_excerpt.csv, caiq_matrix_redacted.pdf, infra/redacted_tf.zip, logs/redacted-app-2026-01.tar.gz. No screenshots, no full runbooks.

infra-bot: export-job queued -> job_id=ev-7721 -> image:evidence-exporter:1.4 -> build:4022

maria-legal: I updated the draft bridge letter and NDA. HelloSign template ready. A note on the bridge letter phrasing: avoid legalese implying warranty; use "expected delivery month" only. I'll send HelloSign to Polaris once we have whitelist + signed NDA.

acct-rep: Kicking off HelloSign now for Polaris (sending NDA + access annex). Will update when signed. Also requested the one-pager; alex — can you draft the quick-access checklist?

alex: I'll post a 1-page checklist in this thread in ~20m (contains steps, contact, IPs, TTL). If HelloSign completes, we can generate links and target sending by 18:00 PST.

ben-eng: Export finished. Waiting on legal greenlight to create presigned links. Files staged at s3://redwood-poc-evidence/1936001234-polaris/{controls_excerpt.csv, caiq_matrix_redacted.pdf, redacted_tf.zip, logs-2026-01.tar.gz}

tariq-sec: Confirmed whitelist: 203.0.113.45, 198.51.100.20. Requestor emails: bob.p@polaris.com, security@polaris.com. Approved.

maria-legal: HelloSign shows NDA signed by Polaris. I'm clearing bridge letter for issuance — adding auditor name per audit firm's consent. Bridge letter + access instructions uploaded to legal drive.

ben-eng: Generating presigned URLs with 72h TTL and proxy-IP enforcement now. Will paste links when ready.

infra-bot: presign-task -> created 4 links -> ttl=259200s -> ip-whitelist applied

ben-eng: Presigned links posted to legal drive and will be shared to Polaris via acct-rep once we confirm they will access from the allowed IPs. (Links are omitted here.)

alex: One-pager checklist (draft): 1) Sign NDA via HelloSign (done) 2) Receive bridge letter (done) 3) Access presigned URLs from approved IPs only 4) Download cap 300MB total 5) Links expire in 72 hours 6) Contact: acct-rep / security@redwood.ai 7) Note: these are redacted excerpts, not the final SOC 2 report.

acct-rep: Sent links to Polaris with the checklist and bridge letter attached. Polaris confirmed they can access from 203.0.113.45. POC kickoff still on for 09:00 PST tomorrow. Thanks team.

maria-legal: Marking thread closed for intake. Keep a copy of the signed NDA + bridge letter in contract repo.
